arabic_text: وَرَؤُوفٍ مَا أَرْأَفَكَ، وَحَكِيمٍ مَا أَعْرَفَكَ!
transliteration: warā'ūfin mā ar'afaka, waḥakīmin mā aʿrafaka!
english_text: The Clement - how clement Thou art! The Wise - how knowing Thou art!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ مِنْ مَلِيْكٍ مَا أَمْنَعَكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka min malikin mā amnaʿaka
english_text: Glory be to Thee! The King - how invincible Thou art!

arabic_text: وَجَوَادٍ مَا أَوْسَعَكَ، وَرَفِيعٍ مَا أَرْفَعَكَ،
transliteration: wajawādin mā awsʿaka, warafīʿin mā arfaʿaka
english_text: The Munificent - how full of plenty Thou art! The Elevated - how elevated Thou art!

arabic_text: ذُو الْبَهاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْحَمْدِ .
transliteration: dhū al-bahā'i wal-majdi wal-kibrīyā'i wal-ḥamd
english_text: Possessor of radiance and glory, magnificence and praise!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ بَسَطْتَ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ يَدَكَ وَعُرِفَتِ الْهِدَايَةُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، فَمَنِ الْتَمَسَكَ لِدِينٍ أَوْ دُنْيا وَجَدَكَ.
transliteration: subḥānaka basaṭta bil-khayrāt yadaka waʿurifati-l-hidāyatu min ʿindika fa mani al-tamassaka l-din aw dunya wajadaka
english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thou hast stretched forth Thy hand with good things, and from Thee guidance has come to be known, so he who begs from Thee religion or this world will find Thee.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ خَضَعَ لَكَ مَنْ جَرى فِي عِلْمِكَ، وَخَشَعَ لِعَظَمَتِكَ مَا دُونَ عَرْشِكَ، وَانْقَادَ لِلتَّسْلِيْمِ لَكَ كُلُّ خَلْقِكَ.
transliteration: subḥānaka khaḍaʿa laka man jarā fī ʿilmika wa-khashaʿa li-ʿazhamatika mā dūna ʿarshika wa inqaḍa li-ttaslīm lika kullu khalqika
english_text: Glory be to Thee! Whatever passes in Thy knowledge is subjected to Thee, all below Thy Throne are humbled before Thy mightiness, and every one of Thy creatures follows Thee in submission.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ لاَ تُحَسَّ، وَلاَ تُجَسُّ، وَلاَ تُمَسُّ، وَلاَ تُكَادُ، وَلاَ تُمَاطُ، وَلاَ تُنَازَعُ، وَلاَ تُجَارى، وَلاَ تُمارى، وَلاَ تُخَادَعُ، وَلاَ تُمَاكَرُ.
transliteration: subḥānaka lā tuḥassa, wa lā tujassu, wa lā tumassu walā tukādu, walā tumāṭu, walā tunāzaʿu, walā tujārī wa lā tumārā, walā tu kh ādāʿu, walā tu mākāru
english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thou art not sensed, nor touched, nor felt, nor beguiled, nor held back, nor challenged, nor kept up with, nor resisted, nor deceived, nor circumvented.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ سَبِيلُكَ جَدَدٌ، وَأَمْرُكَ رَشَدٌ، وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ صَمَدٌ.
transliteration: subḥānaka sabiluka jadadun, wa amruk rashadun, wa ʾanta ḥayyun ṣamadun
english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thy path is smooth ground, Thy command right guidance, and Thou art a living, eternal refuge.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ قَوْلُكَ حُكْمٌ، وَقَضَآؤُكَ حَتْمٌ، وَإرَادَتُكَ عَزْمٌ.
transliteration: subḥānaka qawluka ḥukmun, wa qaḍā'uka ḥatmun, wa irādatuka ʿazmun
english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thy word is decisive, Thy decree unfailing, Thy will resolute.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ لاَ رَادَّ لِمَشِيَّتِكَ، وَلاَ مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِكَ.
transliteration: subḥānaka lā radda li-mashiyatika wa-lā mubaddila li-kalimātika
english_text: Glory be to Thee! None can reject Thy wish, none can change Thy words.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ بَاهِرَ الايآتِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ بَارِئ، النَّسَماتِ.
transliteration: subḥānaka bāhiral-āyāti, fāṭiral-samāwāti bāriʾan-nasamāti
english_text: Glory be to Thee, Outdazzling in signs, Creator of the heavens, Author of the spirits!

arabic_text: لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدَاً يَدُومُ بِدَوامِكَ،
transliteration: laka al-ḥamd, ḥamdan yadūmu bidāwik
english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will be permanent with Thy permanence!

arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً خَالِداً بِنِعْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamdu ḥamdan khālidan binīʿmatika
english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise everlasting through Thy favour!

arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً يُوَازِي صُنْعَكَ،
transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamdu ḥamdan yuwāzī ṣunʿaka
english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will parallel Thy benefaction!

arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً يَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاكَ،
transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamd, ḥamdān yazeedu ʿala riḍaak
english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will increase Thy good pleasure!

arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً مَعَ حَمْدِ كُلِّ حَامِد، وَشُكْراً يَقْصُرُ عَنْهُ شُكْرُ كُلِّ شَاكِر،
transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamd ḥamdan maʿa ḥamdi kulli hāmid wa shukran yaqṣuru ʿanhū shukru kulli shākir
english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise along with the praise of every praiser and a thanksgiving before which falls short the thanksgiving of every thanksgiver;

arabic_text: حَمْداً لاَ يَنْبَغِي إلاَّ لَكَ، وَلاَ يُتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ،
transliteration: ḥamdan lā yanbaghī illā lak wa lā yutaqarrabu bihī illā ʾilayka
english_text: a praise which is suitable for none but Thee and through which nearness is sought to none but Thee;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يُسْتَدَامُ بِهِ الاَوَّلُ، وَيُسْتَدْعَى بِهِ دَوَامُ الاخِرِ،
transliteration: ḥamdan yustadāmu bihī al-awwalu wa yustadaʿā bihī dawāmu al-ākhiri
english_text: a praise which will make permanent the first [bounty] and call forth the permanence of the last;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَتَضَاعَفُ عَلَى كُرُورِ الاَزْمِنَةِ، وَيَتَزَايَدُ أَضْعَافَاً مُتَرَادِفَةً،
transliteration: ḥamdan yataḍāʿafu ʿalā kurūri al-azminah wayatazāyadu 'aḍʿāfān mutarādifatan
english_text: a praise which will multiply through recurrence of times and increase through successive doublings;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَعْجِزُ عَنْ إحْصَآئِهِ الْحَفَظَةُ، وَيَزِيدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْصَتْهُ فِي كِتابِكَ الْكَتَبَةُ،
transliteration: ḥamdān yaʿjizu ʿan iḥṣāʾihi al-ḥafẓatu wayazīdu ʿalā mā aḥṣathu fī kitābika al-katābah
english_text: a praise which the guardians will not be able to number and which exceeds what the writers number in Thy Book;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يُوازِنُ عَرْشَكَ المَجِيْدَ، وَيُعَادِلُ كُرْسِيَّكَ الرَّفِيعَ،
transliteration: ḥamdan yuwāzinu ʿarshaka almaḥīda wayuʿādilu kursiyyaka al-rafiʿa
english_text: a praise which will counterbalance Thy glorious Throne and equal Thy elevated Footstool;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَكْمُلُ لَدَيْكَ ثَوَابُهُ، وَيَسْتَغْرِقُ كُلَّ جَزَآء جَزَآؤُهُ،
transliteration: ḥamdān yakmulu ladayka thawābuhu wa yastaghriqu kulla jazā'in jazā'uhu
english_text: a praise whose reward with Thee will be complete and whose recompense will comprise every recompense;

arabic_text: حَمْداً ظَاهِرُهُ وَفْقٌ لِبَاطِنِهِ، وَبَاطِنُهُ وَفْقٌ لِصِدْقِ النِّيَّةِِ،
transliteration: ḥamdan ẓāhiruhu wafqun libāṭinihi wa bāṭinuhu wafqun li ṣidqi al-niyyah
english_text: a praise whose outward conforms to its inward, and whose inward conforms to correct intention;

arabic_text: حَمْداً لَمْ يَحْمَدْكَ خَلْقٌ مِثْلَهُ، وَلاَ يَعْرِفُ أَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ فَضْلَهُ،
transliteration: ḥamdan lam yaḥmadka khalqun mithlahu walā yaʿrifu ʾaḥadun siwāka faḍlahu
english_text: a praise with whose like no creature has praised Thee and whose excellence none knows but Thou;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يُعَانُ مَنِ اجْتَهَدَ فِي تَعْدِيْدِهِ، وَيُؤَيَّدُ مَنْ أَغْرَقَ نَزْعَاً فِي تَوْفِيَتِهِ،
transliteration: ḥamdan yuʿānu mani jtaḥada fī taʿdeedih wa yu'ayyadu man aghraqa nazʿan fi tawfiyatihi
english_text: a praise in which he who strives to multiply Thy praise will be helped and he who draws the bow to the utmost in fulfilling it will be confirmed;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَجْمَعُ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْحَمْدِ، وَيَنْتَظِمُ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ بَعْدُ،
transliteration: ḥamdān yajmaʿu mā khalaqta min al-ḥamdi wa yantazimu ma anta khaliquhu min baʿdu
english_text: a praise which will gather all the praise which Thou hast created and tie together all which Thou wilt afterwards create;

arabic_text: حَمْداً لاَ حَمْدَ أَقْرَبُ إلَى قَوْلِكَ مِنْهُ، وَلاَ أَحْمَدَ مِمَّنْ يَحْمَدُكَ بِهِ،
transliteration: ḥamdan lā ḥamda aqrabu ʾilā qawlika minhu wa lā ʾaḥmada mimmān yaḥmaduka bihī
english_text: a praise than which no praise is nearer to Thy word and than which none is greater from any who praise Thee;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يُوجِبُ بِكَرَمِكَ الْمَزِيدَ بِوُفُورِهِ وَتَصِلُهُ بِمَزِيْد بَعْدَ مَزِيْد طَوْلاً مِنْكَ،
transliteration: ḥamdan yūjib bika ramika al-mazīda biwufūrihi wa taṣiluhu bimazīd baʿda mazīd ṭawlān mink
english_text: a praise whose fullness will obligate increase through Thy generosity and to which Thou wilt join increase after increase as graciousness from Thee;

arabic_text: حَمْداً يَجِبُ لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ، وَيُقَابِلُ عِزَّ جَلاَلِكَ.
transliteration: ḥamdān yajibu li-karami wajhika wa yuqābilu ʿizza jalālika
english_text: a praise that will befit the generosity of Thy face and meet the might of Thy majesty!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد الْمُنْتَجَبِ، الْمُصْطَفَى، الْمُكَرَّمِ، الْمُقَرَّبِ، أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ، وَبارِكْ عَلَيْهِ أَتَمَّ بَرَكاتِكَ،
transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad al-muntajabi, al-mustafa al-mukarramī, al-muqarrabī, afḍala ṣalawātika wa bārik ʿalayhi atammabarakātika
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, the distinguished, the chosen, the honoured, the brought nigh, with the most excellent of Thy blessings, benedict him with the most complete of Thy benedictions,
